data.name: Module.SystemManager.Description
data.value: Manages system configuration and core runtime data. Do not remove it; back up data before changes.

data.name: Function.SystemManager.UpdateCloudAccount.Description
data.value: Bind a NeuChar cloud account with the AppKey and Secret from the developer page to activate advanced features

data.name: Function.SystemManager.ViewTempLog.Description
data.value: Query a temporary log by the RequestTempId returned from AppService while it remains valid

data.name: Parameter.SystemManager.AppSecret
data.value: NeuChar AppSecret||Find your Secret at https://www.neuchar.com/Developer/Developer. Never disclose it.

data.name: Parameter.SystemManager.RequestTempId
data.value: RequestTempId||The requestTempId returned by AppService, for example: RequestTempId-639189862069965960-fc2ab5f5
